_comment: Extra material for project pages, keyed by project slug (see lib/content.ts). Everything here is optional: a project without an entry still gets a page built from its `about` text. `metric` appears on project rows; `title` is a shorter name for rows (the page keeps the full one); `headline` replaces the title on the case study; `sections` replace the single paragraph. `featured` sets the home page order.

kronos.summary: A greedy scheduler that turned an NP-hard timetabling problem into a ten-minute job. The College of Engineering at KNUST adopted it as its official scheduling tool.

sections.title: The problem
sections.body: Lecture timetables for the College of Engineering were built by hand, and each one took about two months. Timetabling is NP-hard, so there is no fast way to find a perfect answer.

sections.title: The approach
sections.body: A greedy algorithm that weighs soft constraints, including how comfortable a schedule is for lecturers and students and how far apart lecture halls are, to reach a workable weekly timetable.

sections.title: The result
sections.body: A timetable in ten minutes instead of two months. The front end was built from scratch in TypeScript with React and Tailwind CSS, backed by a Spring Boot service on AWS EC2. The college now uses it as its official tool.

retainyourbrain.summary: Retain Health's flagship consumer app, used regularly by 60,000+ people, with Gemini-powered conversational check-ins that support patients in keeping to their routines.

retainmd-clinician-portal-emr.title: RetainMD EMR
retainmd-clinician-portal-emr.summary: A clinician-facing EMR supporting a 5,000+ patient clinical trial, where I turned an ad hoc clinical reporting process into a state-based, auditable workflow.

sections.title: The problem
sections.body: Patient reports followed an ad hoc clinical process. In a clinical trial, every report has to be reliable and every change has to be accountable.

sections.title: The approach
sections.body: I designed the Patient Report workflow as a state-based pipeline (draft, review, sign-off, published) with explicit status transitions, and led the Patient Report v3 workspace: a multi-tab clinician experience with live report preview, built from clinical stakeholder requirements.

sections.title: The result
sections.body: A reliable, auditable system, extended with patient-facing report generation and a clinician review and sign-off workflow. Gemini now assists clinicians as they author insights and checks report content against biomarkers and other clinical inputs.

shared-serverless-platform-fda-complianc.title: Serverless platform
shared-serverless-platform-fda-complianc.summary: The serverless AWS backend shared by all three of Retain Health's products, running at 99.99% uptime, with FDA regulatory validation built into CI/CD.

sections.title: The platform
sections.body: A shared Node.js and TypeScript backend on AWS Lambda, CDK, RDS, S3 and API Gateway, serving the consumer app, the clinician EMR and the internal admin portal, with HIPAA-compliant handling of patient and clinical data.

sections.title: Compliance in the pipeline
sections.body: Working with the FDA compliance team, I built regulatory validation directly into CI/CD, so every release is validated as part of the pipeline.

sections.title: The result
sections.body: Release cycles 3 months faster, 99.99% uptime, and a nationwide clinical trial launch for 5,000+ patients.
